title: 4 Space Facts That Will Break Your Brain

scenes.text: We have mapped the entire Moon, but space keeps getting stranger the deeper we look. Here are four facts that will genuinely break your brain.
Number four. A single day on Venus lasts longer than its entire year. The planet spins that slowly.
Number three. The fastest neutron stars spin over seven hundred times every single second. One teaspoon of their matter weighs billions of tons.
Number two. Near the center of our galaxy floats a giant cloud that smells like rum, and tastes like raspberries.
And number one. Astronomers found a planet that may be one third diamond. It is twice the width of Earth, and eight times heavier.
And here is the scary part. We have barely begun to explore our own galaxy. Imagine what is still hiding out there. Follow for more space secrets.
